notes: A hire car is essential (Lindos, Prasonisi, the west). KTEL buses run regularly along the east coast (Lindos takes 1.5 hours). The airport bus costs 3 EUR.
From November to March it is 12-18°C, most beach facilities and Lindos tavernas are closed, and the Old Town and villages are quiet. April-May and October are ideal (sea at 22°C).
The palace costs 12 EUR (April-October), the Lindos acropolis 12 and the Symi ferry 30. A taverna meal runs 20-30. For tips, round up the bill.
The ferry from Marmaris takes 1 hour (Schengen visa needed for Turkish citizens). There is also a summer ferry from Fethiye.
Try pitaroudia, melekouni (sesame and honey bar), souma (grape spirit) and Symi shrimp, plus Embona wines.
Pickpockets are rare in the Old Town. Motor vehicles cannot enter, so you will need to walk with your luggage.

stops.name: Palace of the Grand Master
stops.tips: The knights' 14th-century palace (restored by Mussolini), with mosaics from Kos. Part of the UNESCO-listed Old Town.

stops.name: Street of the Knights
stops.tips: Ippoton Street, lined with the inns of the seven languages (France, Spain and others) and stone arches.

stops.name: Sokratous Street & Suleymaniye Mosque
stops.tips: The Ottoman bazaar street from the Turkish period (1522-1912), with the mosque and a Turkish library.

stops.name: Mandraki Harbour Deer
stops.tips: The deer columns stand where the Colossus of Rhodes is said to have been. Take in the windmills and the Fort of St Nicholas.

stops.name: Nireas Rhodes Old Town
stops.tips: A taverna under a vine canopy, serving octopus. It sits near the Jewish Quarter (Evreon Martyron).

backups.name: Marco Polo Café
backups.tips: A garden in an Ottoman mansion, also open in the evening.

backups.name: Old Town Walls
backups.tips: Guided walks along the top of the walls run on set days. Walking the moat is free.

stops.name: Lindos Acropolis
stops.tips: Take the bus (1.5 hours, leave at 08:00) or drive. See the Temple of Athena Lindia and views over St Paul's Bay. Go when it opens at 08:00, as midday reaches 40°C, and walk rather than ride a donkey.

stops.name: Lindos Village
stops.tips: White captains' houses with pebble-mosaic courtyards, narrow lanes and the Church of Panagia.

stops.name: St Paul's Bay
stops.tips: The bay is calm in winter, though swimming takes some courage.

stops.name: Mavrikos Lindos
stops.tips: A square-side taverna since 1933, serving seafood and listed in the Michelin guide.

stops.name: Lindos Main Beach
stops.tips: A winter beach walk with the acropolis lit up above.

backups.name: Captain's House Lindos
backups.tips: A bar in a captain's house in Lindos.

backups.name: Pefkos Beach
backups.tips: A quiet beach south of Lindos.

stops.name: Kallithea Springs
stops.tips: A 1929 Italian Art Deco spa with mosaic courtyards. Swim and snorkel in the cove.

stops.name: Anthony Quinn Bay
stops.tips: The cove from the Greek film Zorba. Turquoise water, pebbles and rock, empty in the morning, with sunbeds.

stops.name: Faliraki Beach
stops.tips: A long sandy beach with beach tavernas, good for lunch.

stops.name: Tsambika Beach
stops.tips: Golden sand and shallow water. The monastery on the hill is up 300 steps and comes with a fertility legend.

stops.name: Tsambika Monastery Sunset
stops.tips: A hilltop monastery with a panorama of the coast.

backups.name: Ladiko Beach
backups.tips: Anthony Quinn's neighbouring cove, and quieter.

stops.name: Symi Ferry Mandraki
stops.tips: The Dodecanese high-speed ferry takes 1 hour (return about 30 EUR) and arrives at Yialos harbour.

stops.name: Yialos Harbour Symi
stops.tips: Pastel neoclassical houses rise like an amphitheatre around what is often called Greece's most beautiful harbour.

stops.name: Kali Strata Stairs & Chorio
stops.tips: 500 steps up to the old town, with a castle and views. It is cooler in the morning.

stops.name: Symi Shrimp at Manos Fish
stops.tips: Small fried Symi shrimp, eaten shell and all, by the harbour.

stops.name: Panormitis Monastery
stops.tips: The monastery of the Archangel Michael, where the ferry calls. It is the holiest in the Dodecanese. Return between 16:00 and 17:00.

backups.name: Nos Beach Symi
backups.tips: A small beach beside the harbour, an alternative to the monastery (depending on the ferry route).

backups.name: Tholos Symi
backups.tips: A seafront taverna at the end of the harbour.

stops.name: Valley of the Butterflies Petaloudes
stops.tips: There are no butterflies in winter, but you get a green stream walk and waterfalls.

stops.name: Ancient Kamiros
stops.tips: The Hellenistic "Pompeii of Rhodes", with a sea-view agora and a cistern.

stops.name: Kritinia Castle
stops.tips: The ruins of a knights' castle, with free views over the Aegean.

stops.name: Kritinia Village Taverna
stops.tips: On the village square: goat and pitaroudia (chickpea fritters).

stops.name: Embona Wine Village
stops.tips: Wine tasting at the foot of Mount Attavyros (Emery, Alexandris) in a mountain village.

backups.name: Monastery of Filerimos
backups.tips: On Ialysos hill, with a Calvary path, a giant cross and peacocks. An alternative to Kamiros.

stops.name: Prasonisi
stops.tips: It becomes an island in winter when the water rises. Expect windswept views.

stops.name: Prasonisi Taverna Lighthouse
stops.tips: The only cluster of tavernas on the sand spit, serving fish.

stops.name: Kiotari Beach
stops.tips: A long, quiet beach on the way back.

stops.name: Asklipio Castle & Village
stops.tips: Byzantine church frescoes and a castle in an inland village.

stops.name: Gennadi Beach Sunset
stops.tips: An empty pebble beach. The drive back takes 1.5 hours.

backups.name: Kiotari Taverna Paraga
backups.tips: On the beach, an alternative to Prasonisi.

backups.name: Monolithos Castle
backups.tips: A castle on a rock on the west coast with sunset views. An alternative route.

stops.name: Elli Beach Morning
stops.tips: The city beach, with a diving platform and the Turkish coast in view.

stops.name: Rhodes Aquarium
stops.tips: An Italian aquarium from the 1930s, out on the headland.

stops.name: Nea Agora Mandraki Breakfast
stops.tips: The round courtyard of the New Market, for coffee and loukoumades (honey doughnuts).

stops.name: Rhodes Airport Bus
stops.tips: The bus to Diagoras Airport takes 30 minutes. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Koskinou Village
backups.tips: A village of colourful doors, an alternative to the aquarium.
